name: Shiga Shingo
source:
A mysterious transfer student who has been enrolled in Baramon High School since May.
His cold attitude toward other people makes him feel out of the place. 
As he indulges in loneliness as if he were a lone wolf, who would've thought that Shingo actually holds a confidential dark secret deep down his heart...? 

"...Shut up."
